_comment: Machine-readable list of the evidence artifacts each phase must produce.
How to write the criteria behind them: docs/design/acceptance-criteria.md.
Validator: tests/test_evidence_artifacts.py. Keep this file and the plan in step;
this file wins, because it is the one a machine reads.
This file lists what MUST exist. It never states which phase is current -- that is
SEED CONTENT: the 'example' phase below is a worked illustration. Replace it with
your project's phases. Leaving it in place costs nothing -- the default run passes
vacuously -- but it gates nothing either.
_forbidden_comment: Secrets and machine-specific values, rejected anywhere in an artifact including its
header. This is a backstop, not your first line -- redact before saving.
Each entry is [what it is, regex].
_phases_comment: phase -> list of artifacts. Per-artifact keys:
file             required, the filename under artifact_dir
id, title        required, for human-readable gate failures
optional         true = never blocks a gate
implies          if this artifact exists, these must exist too
requires_fields  extra header fields this artifact must carry
must_contain     regexes the body must match
must_not_contain regexes the body must not match

example.title: Example: an observation only a person or an instrument can make
Example: the same observation repeated under load
Example: a reversible detour that must be undone before the gate closes
Example: proof the detour was reverted
